headline: From bare frame
to finished wall.
copy.sub: Skimming, rendering, drylining and pebble dash across Reigate and Surrey since 2007. Free estimates, and a tidy finish ready for decorating.
copy.alt: Two Affordable Plastering Services plasterers skimming an arched wall from a scaffold tower
copy.about_alt: The Affordable Plastering Services team rendering the front of a house in Reigate
copy.lede: Jerry O'Sullivan set up Affordable Plastering Services in 2007. He and his team plaster, board and render homes across Reigate and Surrey, from patching a few ceiling holes to whole barn and loft conversions, and they've looked after one customer's portfolio of care homes for years.
copy.services_intro: Inside and out, old houses and new builds.

services.title: Skimming and plastering
services.blurb: Walls and ceilings skimmed smooth, or hacked off and re-plastered when the old stuff has blown.
services.intro: A fresh skim over sound walls, or a full re-plaster where the old plaster is loose or hollow.
includes: Making good after electricians and plumbers

services.title: Drylining and boarding
services.blurb: Stud walls, loft and extension boarding, dot and dab and taped joints ready to skim.
services.intro: New rooms boarded straight and flat, with the joints taped so the skim goes on clean.
includes: Dot and dab on old walls

services.title: Rendering
services.blurb: Sand and cement, K Rend and monocouche through-colour renders for fronts, extensions and garden rooms.
services.intro: External walls rendered to keep the weather out and look sharp for years.

services.title: Pebble dash
services.blurb: Pebble dashing and rough casting, new or patched in to match what you have.
services.intro: Tired or cracked dash repaired, or a whole wall done fresh.

services.title: Ceilings, Artex and coving
services.blurb: Artex covered, cracked ceilings flattened, coving fitted and holes made good.
services.intro: Ceilings are where bad plastering shows. Ours go flat, smooth and ready to paint.

services.title: Lime, lath and polished plaster
services.blurb: Lime and lath for older houses, plus Venetian, polished and magnetic plaster finishes.
services.intro: Period houses need materials that breathe, and feature walls deserve a finish that stands out.

steps.title: The shell
steps.text: Insulation in, steels up, stud walls framed. Nothing to look at yet.

steps.title: Boarded
steps.text: Every wall and slope boarded and the joints taped, so the skim goes on flat.

steps.title: Skimmed
steps.text: Fresh skim on the ceilings and walls, left pink to dry out properly.

steps.title: Dried out
steps.text: Smooth, even and ready for the decorators. Same room as the first photo.

steps.title: Ready to live in
steps.text: Big glass, high ceilings and clean lines that a good plaster finish makes possible.

How long before I can paint new plaster?
Usually 3 to 7 days for a skim, longer for a full re-plaster. It goes from dark to light pink and even in colour when it's dry.
Yes. Most Artex can be skimmed over after preparation. Older Artex may need testing for asbestos first.
